caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with a repeating floral pattern. The background is a deep blue color, while the floral and leafy motifs are rendered in a beige or light tan hue. The pattern features various stylized flowers, clusters of small buds, and branching leafy stems distributed evenly across the entire surface. The fabric’s texture is visible, with horizontal and vertical lines indicating the weave. The edges of the cloth are slightly irregular, and the bottom edge has a frayed appearance. The drawing has a border of blank space around the fabric sample, and in the bottom right corner, the name "M. R. BEVIER" is printed.
title: Resist Fabric
